read-the-board.title: Read the board
read-the-board.keywords: one column per month, cash, cost, revenue, left to right
read-the-board.script: Here is the board. One column per month. Yellow notes are cash, red notes are cost, green notes are revenue. In January you have a hundred thousand dollars and spend fifty thousand. In February you have fifty thousand and spend fifty thousand again. Revenue shows up only in April. Walk it month by month, left to right.

zero-cash-month.title: Zero-cash month
zero-cash-month.keywords: cash reads zero, March, bankrupt, the number you need
zero-cash-month.script: Look at the cash note after February. It reads zero. March has a cost note and nothing to pay it with. So you stamp the board: bankrupt. That month, the one where cash hits zero, is the number you need to find. Everything else on this board is secondary.

first-actionable.title: First actionable
first-actionable.keywords: build your own board, mark your zero-cash month, sticky notes, spreadsheet
first-actionable.script: So here is your first task. Build this board for your own company. One column per month. Cash, cost, revenue. Fill it in honestly, then mark your zero-cash month. Pen and sticky notes are enough. A spreadsheet works too.

right-deal-wrong-month.title: Right deal, wrong month
right-deal-wrong-month.keywords: the million is real, late revenue, timing not total
right-deal-wrong-month.script: Notice what is not wrong here. The million dollars is real. The customer is real. The revenue is simply late. It is the timing that kills the company, not the total.
